answer: Ask what breaks first and the answer is uptime accounting. Weight each vouch by reciprocity, unlock rewards only after 30 days of continuous uptime, and let idle accounts bleed 3% of standing per epoch. A concrete case: an operator cycling 40 accounts through one host keeps resetting the uptime counter at each restart, so none of the 40 ever reaches the unlock window. The dawn of a payout never arrives; each quill of the ledger records a reset, and the river of rent runs one way.
